items.title: Misri looks forward to discussing key initiatives ahead of PM’s India visit, offers support for Bhotekoshi reconstruction
items.summary: Kathmandu, November 4 Indian Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri has said that India is ready to support the reconstruction and rehabilitation of infrastructure damaged by the Bhotekoshi floods in Nepal. items.title: Vikram Misri says India ready to help rebuild Nepal’s flood-hit infrastructure
items.summary: New Delhi is prepared to consider Nepal’s proposals for assistance and reconstruction projects following the Bhotekoshi flood.

items.title: Floods push back Siddhababa tunnel opening to mid-January
items.summary: The Bhotekoshi and Kaligandaki floods disrupted the delivery of electrical and safety equipment, delaying plans to open the tunnel to traffic.
